Why I switched to local-first notes

For years I kept every note in a cloud service. When the service changed its pricing overnight, I realized how little control I had over my own writing and research.

Local-first apps store your data on your own devices and sync in the background. They keep working offline, they are fast, and you can always export plain Markdown files.

In this post I compare three local-first note-taking tools and explain how I migrated thousands of notes without losing links between them.
